narrative.overview: KOC Discovery wears the DETOLA brand as a working tool: cream ground, white softly rounded cards, navy ink and dark blocks, one DETOLA orange for the next action, teal for done and good. Inside, content stays dense and exact: tabular figures, hairline navy rules, verdicts spelled out, evidence one click away. Hierarchy comes from weight, tight tracking, the navy-over-grey two-tone headline and the cream-to-white step, not colour floods or heavy shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Cream ground, white cards, navy-10% hairlines, one soft shadow
Navy for text and dark blocks; orange fill only for the primary action, AI avatar, send button and dots
Teal for completed and positive; amber and brick only for attention states
12px controls, 16px chat/step panels, 20px cards, pills for tags and choices
Every status and verdict carries a word

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange fill only on the primary action, AI avatar, send button and dots; orange as text or line uses #b54620.

rules.name: The Navy-On-Orange Rule
rules.body: Text on orange is navy (5.2:1), never white.

rules.name: The Word-With-Colour Rule
rules.body: Teal, amber and brick always ride with a word.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Comparable numbers are tabular and right-aligned.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Headline Rule
rules.body: Page titles are a navy line plus an ink-mute line at display size; ink-mute never below 30px.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: One barely-there shadow; hierarchy comes from cream versus white.

dos: Do reserve orange fills for the one primary action per view, the AI avatar and status dots.
Do use #b54620 whenever orange is read as text, line or focus.
Do pair every verdict and status colour with its word.
Do keep numbers tabular and right-aligned.
Do use the off-ramp sizes (11, 12, 14, 17, 19, 20, 30, 32px) only in their components.
donts: Don't put white text on DETOLA orange or set body text in raw orange.
Don't use ink-mute below 30px or for needed information.
Don't copy DETOLA's logo or mascot illustrations.
Don't add a second shadow, hard offset shadows, gradients or dark neon surfaces.
Don't use more than one kicker per page, and only above the page title.
